changes.title: Hide shadow
items: Animals slipping away between attacks (into the trees, underground, under water, or scattering) now show as a dark see-through shadow of themselves running round, fading in and out, instead of vanishing

changes.title: Sigils bigger
items: The sigils in your stack and over the rune stones are half as big again, so you can tell which animal each one is

changes.title: Station backdrop
items: At a station the room behind the witch goes darker, so she stands out
